wedo_instance.description: LexClinic Education, Inc. Cloudflare Website Development, Verification Gates, and Deployment Manifest

meta.philosophy: LexClinic Web Substrate: Fast, secure, and modern web interface deployed to Cloudflare Pages (stage.lex.clinic -> lex.clinic) protected by mandatory static-analysis linters and automated runtime tests.

future_cell_verification_protocol.mandate: Every future agent cell modifying any file in kairos_repsl/website/ MUST run both the 7-rule Contract Linter and the 4-suite Runtime & Integration Test Runner before deploying or committing.
linter_rules: 01-window-contracts.js: Verifies all 31 global window.* functions in contracts.config.json are exported in js/
02-event-listener-links.js: Verifies 100% of inline HTML onclick/onsubmit handlers map to defined JS functions
03-route-integrity.js: Verifies 100% of internal href links resolve to existing HTML files or _redirects rules
04-spotify-101-embeds.js: Verifies all 12 /101/ modules (1.1-6.2) for on-disk audio.m4a (>100KB), YouTube lecture, Spotify episode, watch meters, quiz.html, and transcripts.json parity
05-event-pages-contracts.js: Verifies all 9 recorded /event/ pages (2026-08-13 to 2026-10-22) for on-disk audio.m4a, YouTube clips, watch meters, and transcripts.json parity
06-interview-pages-contracts.js: Verifies all /interview/ pages (lucas-kung 11 clips, james-wigginton 3 clips) for on-disk audio.m4a, watch meters, quiz.html, and transcripts.json parity
07-attest-contracts.js: Verifies /attest/ and /erc7827/ (/ERC-7827/) DOM IDs, Media Approvals Ledger integration, and 100% bidirectional parity across all 19 quiz.html files

08-mobile-responsiveness.js: Verifies responsive viewport meta tags, #mobile-toggle & #nav-links presence, @media (max-width: 768px) CSS cascade order, touch double-fire protection, and zero rigid >340px inline min-widths across all HTML pages
test_suites: 01-client-js-runtime.test.js: VM unit tests for @lex.clinic auth, 24h disclaimer splash, 2-step media approvals (Thorough/Cursory -> Pass/Star/Flag/Fail), legacy card ID aliases, and localStorage -> /api/media-notes sync
02-quiz-engine.test.js: VM tests for Two-Tier (5-Q Core -> 20-Q Mastery) quiz progression, pass-threshold gating, and 66-char 0x Keccak-256/SHA-256 attestation payloads

03-serverless-functions.test.js: Direct handler tests for _middleware.js (Staging Basic Auth isolation), /api/transcripts, /mcp/sse JSON-RPC tools, and /api/media-notes Google Drive ledger persistence
04-live-staging-e2e.test.js: Live HTTP 200 smoke tests on https://stage.lex.clinic and HTTP 206 byte-range MP4 'ftyp' header verification across all 11 live event/interview audio.m4a streams

05-mobile-ux-and-toggle.test.js: VM unit tests for #mobile-toggle hamburger state machine (☰ <-> ✕), touch double-fire prevention, event category filter pills (filterEventsByCategory), and mobile CSS single-column grid overrides
future_cell_verification_protocol.how_to_extend: When adding a new 101 module, event, interview, or quiz, append its route and expected media IDs to Rules 04/05/06/07 and Suite 04, then run both runners until 0 failures.

tasks.description: Export Cloudflare Account ID and API Token into local environment
Verify Cloudflare API Token authentication and list accounts/zones
Build the lex.clinic frontend web application in lex_clinic_website/
Deploy website to Cloudflare Pages project 'lex-clinic' and bind lex.clinic domain
Build Modular DOM & Function Contract Linter System in .linter/ to prevent silent feature loss
Add Rule 03 Route Integrity Linter (03-route-integrity.js), restore exact splash disclaimer copy, and add Lucas Kung route redirect

Restore faststart audio.m4a streams across all 101 modules (1.1-5.2), restore 11 authentic YouTube explainer clips to Lukas Kung interview, and enforce Rule 04 (101), Rule 05 (Event), and Rule 06 (Interview) linters

Restore /erc7827/ and /ERC-7827/ routes, bind persistent Cloudflare KV + Google Drive ledger for media approvals/notes with auto-sync from browser localStorage, rebuild /attest/ with all 19 quizzes + media approvals ledger, and enforce Rule 07 (/attest/ & /erc7827/ linter)

Build automated runtime and integration test suite (.tests/runner.js) covering client JS state machines (Test 01), Two-Tier 5->20 quiz engine & Keccak-256 attestations (Test 02), Cloudflare Pages Functions & MCP JSON-RPC (Test 03), and live staging E2E + HTTP 206 audio byte-range verification (Test 04)

Implement canonical dual-route quiz addresses (quiz-learned/ for 5-Q Learned Tier and quiz-expert/ for 20-Q Expert Tier) across all 19 quizzes with smart entry routing on quiz.html, 💬 Notes & 👍 Approval control bars (without Copy Direct Link), and linter/test enforcement

Rewrite 101/1.1 through 101/4.1 and 101/ comprehensive quizzes (both 5-Q quiz-learned and 20-Q quiz-expert) directly from their verified Whisper media transcripts in transcripts.json, and enforce transcript-keyword grounding in Linter Rule 07

Restructure /event/ to show Upcoming Events, the 3 Most Recent Recorded Events (Oct 22, Oct 15, Oct 8), and dedicated Monthly Archive pages (/event/2026-10/, /event/2026-09/, /event/2026-08/) with event subcategory filtering (Classes, Interviews, Director Calls, Partner Calls) and date-stamped interview routes

Remove unrecorded past Director/Partner calls from past archives, badge Socratic classes explicitly as 101 Live Socratic Sessions, and add bidirectional companion links between all /101/X.Y/ module pages and their corresponding /event/YYYY-MM-DD/ Socratic session pages

Fix mobile touch double-fire bug on #mobile-toggle, add comprehensive @media (max-width: 768px) single-column and button-stacking overrides at the bottom of styles.css, and enforce mobile responsiveness in Linter Rule 08 and Test Suite 05

Restore exact Socratic Event <-> 101 Class bijection (Aug 22 Clinic+ExpWit, Aug 24 <-> 1.2, Aug 28 <-> 2.1, Sept 4 <-> 2.2, Sept 17 <-> 3.1, Sept 24 <-> 3.2, Oct 1 <-> 4.1, Oct 8 <-> 4.2, Oct 15 <-> 5.1, Oct 22 <-> 5.2) with authentic YouTube clip IDs, remove duplicate Aug 13/20 pages, and tighten quiz CTAs to a single progressive button with prerequisite gating on /quiz-expert/
